# Vendored Sign in with ChatGPT SDK

This directory contains the unmodified `packages/local` source from OpenAI's
[Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit](https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit)
at commit `0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a`.

The package license is in `packages/local/LICENSE` (Sign-in with ChatGPT DevKit
Noncommercial License v1.0). The integration is gated for personal, local use.
Commercial use or use for an employer/client requires separate written rights.

The SDK and OAuth credentials stay in DocForm's trusted local Node process.
Do not move SDK calls or credentials into the browser renderer.
